name: SpecForge Magenta
source: Chosen by the product owner from design/prototypes/brand-directions.html. ADR 0002.
notes: Grounds are neutral greys with no hue: a clean off-white in light, a true dark black in dark. The accent is the only colour that is not a state.
line is a decorative hairline with no contrast floor. field is a control boundary and clears 3:1 per WCAG 1.4.11.
Light brand is darkened from the prototype's #e4127a so one token clears 4.5:1 both as text on the ground and under a white label.
